My message to doctors, nurses, and other healthcare providers: I’ll create a state where you can spend more time caring for patients instead of filling out mountains of paperwork. That actually goes hand-in-hand with combating Medicaid fraud.

It’s time for a fresh approach in Ohio.

There are literally 10 different agencies in the Ohio government bureaucracy that administer Medicaid payments. It’s unnecessarily complicated, makes audits impossible, and diffuses accountability. That will change once I take office.

Video

We’re going to go so fast they won’t know what hit them. Laying out the plan to combat Medicaid fraud in Ohio later this morning.

We’re going to crush Medicaid fraud in Ohio aggressively, using emergency measures, starting on Day 1. Press conference starting at 10:30am to lay it out.
